title: Nonlocal eigenvalue problems and superposition operators
summary: We study the spectral theory of mixed local and nonlocal operators with lower-order terms in the right-hand side of the equation. This kind of problems is motivated by the analysis of superposition operators of mixed order and with the "wrong sign" of the lower-order terms with respect to the classical elliptic theory.
